name: acs/webhook-secret-too-short
description: 2.0. A new webhook subscription whose secret is shorter than 32 characters is refused (400 ErrInvalidRequest). In the production profile a plain-http target_url is refused the same way. Subscriptions that already exist are not affected.
captured_from: RECORDED from a running ACS (cmd/api + cmd/bssadapter + Postgres) at commit c9c94ff, 2026-11-15. Secrets and tokens redacted.

body.title: Invalid request
body.detail: secret must be at least 32 characters: it is the only thing that lets the receiver tell a real event from a forged one
